test_conditions: Original generic 280–294 eV window with 3 known mixed-line-shape components and counting noise. No compound identity, measured composition or fitting quality claim.

render_options.fit_method: Known Gaussian/Lorentzian mixtures plus Poisson counts; no optimizer
render_options.charge_reference: Synthetic energy axis; no measured calibration

reference.observation: XPS spectra and component fits; our labels remain generic because no chemical assignment is evidenced
reference.review_scope: publisher text/caption; no numerical data or original artwork copied

assumptions: Nonnegative independent counting statistics on known generic components and a linear background.
The mixture width is a shape parameter; it is not claimed as a common Gaussian/Lorentzian FWHM.

references.supports: The Gaussian mathematical line shape only; no material peak assignment or numeric data.

limitations: No optimizer, fitted composition, charge calibration, Shirley/Tougaard background or chemical assignment.
